paragraphs.text: Medran is a market town in the nation of Efuan Pincar on the great island of Gulmany , part of the Terisian Isles on modern day Dominaria .

It was in Medran, c. 3250 AR , that Xantcha found the man she was looking for - a young, dark-haired, and rude man named Ratepe . She bought him off the slaver Tucktah , and bid him put on the role as Mishra to hopefully trigger Urza into action. Medran was also where Xantcha realized Efuan Pincar had become infiltrated by sleeper agents .
